name: Guardian of the Mire

start.dialog: There are people trapped in the deep Mire. Survivors from a caravan. Dominion left them to die. I won't. But I need backup. You in?
start.objective: Accompany Lightning to rescue survivors from the deep Mire

progress.dialog: The survivors are close. I can hear them. Stay sharp - the Mire's creatures are everywhere.
progress.objective: Fight through Mire creatures to reach the survivors

complete.dialog: We got them out. All of them. That's what matters. Here - my old Guardian Corps badge. I'm not that person anymore. Maybe it'll mean something to you.

party_comments.kade: She doesn't hesitate. Just acts. I respect that.
party_comments.korr: Military training shows. Clean, efficient tactics.
party_comments.vex: Protecting the innocent. A worthy calling.

hidden_outcome: If you rescue all survivors without any injuries, Lightning gives you 'Omega Weapon' - a powerful gunblade
